# Chiliz Chain Developer Docs

## English

- [Chiliz Chain developer docs](https://docs.chiliz.com/readme.md)
- [Quick Start](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start.md): Quick-start hub for Ethereum-savvy developers: Chiliz Chain network params, testnet faucets, smart contract deployment and verification, and running a node.
- [Chiliz Chain in a nutshell](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/chiliz-chain-in-a-nutshell.md): High-level overview of Chiliz Chain: EVM-compatible sports blockchain with PoSA consensus, CHZ native token, on-chain governance, and Ethereum interoperability.
- [Developer Toolbox](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/developer-toolbox.md): Mainnet and Spicy Testnet RPC parameters, free CHZ testnet faucets, contract deployment and verification guides, and Docker node launch commands.
- [Connect to Mainnet and Testnet](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/developer-toolbox/connect-to-mainnet-and-testnet.md): Network parameters for connecting to Chiliz Chain Mainnet (Chain ID 88888) and Spicy Testnet (88882), including RPC endpoints and explorer URLs.
- [Obtain testnet tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/developer-toolbox/obtain-testnet-tokens.md): Get free test CHZ tokens for Chiliz Spicy Testnet via the Spicy Faucet or Tatum Faucet to develop and test your dApp without financial risk.
- [Deploy and verify a contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/developer-toolbox/deploy-and-verify-a-contract.md): Deploy and verify a smart contract on Chiliz Chain in two steps — from compiling the contract to confirming it on the block explorer.
- [Run a Chiliz Chain Node](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/developer-toolbox/run-a-chiliz-chain-node.md): Run your own Chiliz Chain full node using Docker for greater control and privacy. Covers setup parameters for both Mainnet and Spicy Testnet.
- [Starter Kits](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/starter-kits.md): Starter kits for building on Chiliz Chain — step-by-step guides for launching NFT collections and ERC-20 crypto tokens.
- [Create NFTs for Your Sports Team](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/starter-kits/create-nfts-for-your-sports-team.md): Step-by-step starter kit to launch a sports team NFT collection on Chiliz Chain: file preparation, IPFS hosting, ERC-721/ERC-1155 selection, thirdweb deployment, and OKX listing.
- [Launch a crypto token](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/starter-kits/launch-a-crypto-token.md): Complete guide to launching an ERC-20 token on Chiliz Chain: Solidity contract with OpenZeppelin, Remix deployment, FanX/Kayen liquidity pool creation, DEX listing, and token launch strategy.
- [Free online courses](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/free-online-courses.md): Free online learning resources for building on Chiliz Chain: HyperNest 3-month bootcamp with VC access, and Rise In course covering Moralis, thirdweb, and NFT marketplaces.
- [Inflation Supply Allocation Addresses](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/inflation-supply-allocation-addresses.md): Official Chiliz Chain Mainnet and Spicy Testnet wallet addresses for Dragon8 inflation supply allocation: Community Vault/LP and Ecosystem & Operational Distribution.
- [Smart Contract Addresses](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/smart-contract-addresses.md): Complete reference of Chiliz Chain system contract addresses: Staking, Governance, ChainConfig, Tokenomics, Fan Token staking, Pepper, and LayerZero endpoint contracts for chain IDs 88888 and 88882.
- [Token Contract Addresses](https://docs.chiliz.com/quick-start/token-contract-addresses.md): Full list of Fan Token and CHZ contract addresses across Chiliz Chain, Solana, and Base, covering 60+ sports clubs and organizations including $PSG, $BAR, $JUV, and $CITY.
- [Learn](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn.md): Conceptual guides covering Chiliz Chain architecture, CHZ tokenomics, bridging, staking, validators, Fan Tokens, stablecoins, DAOs, and wallets.
- [About Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-chiliz-chain.md): Chiliz Chain fundamentals: EVM compatibility, PoSA consensus, Parlia engine, CHZ native token, validator set, and sports-and-entertainment ecosystem focus.
- [Tokenomics](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-chiliz-chain/tokenomics.md): Chiliz Chain Tokenomics 2.0: 8.80% initial inflation with exponential decay to 1.88% floor, EIP-1559 fee burning, validator/delegator reward split, and Pepper8-updated supply roadmap.
- [Security Audits](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-chiliz-chain/security-audits.md): Security audit reports for Chiliz Chain's governance contracts, Fan Token contract, Chiliz Bridge, and Tokenomics by Certik and Halborn.
- [Chiliz Greenhouse](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-chiliz-chain/chiliz-greenhouse.md): Chiliz Greenhouse program: micro-grants, technical bounties, and mentorship for builders, plus the Greenhouse Hub showcase for SportFi projects.
- [About Wallets](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-wallets.md): Overview of Web3 wallets for Chiliz Chain: MetaMask browser extension, Safe multisig, and Socios.com Wallet for Fan Token interactions.
- [How to use MetaMask](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-wallets/how-to-use-metamask.md): Step-by-step guides to install MetaMask and connect it to Chiliz Chain Mainnet and Spicy Testnet, with seed phrase safety warnings.
- [Install MetaMask](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-wallets/how-to-use-metamask/install-metamask.md): Install the MetaMask browser extension from the Chrome Web Store to create and manage a Web3 wallet for Chiliz Chain.
- [Link Chiliz Chain and MetaMask](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-wallets/how-to-use-metamask/link-chiliz-chain-and-metamask.md): Add Chiliz Chain Mainnet and Spicy Testnet as custom networks in MetaMask using RPC URL and chain ID configuration.
- [How to use a multisig wallet (Safe)](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-wallets/how-to-use-a-multisig-wallet-safe.md): Set up and use a Safe (Gnosis Safe) multisig wallet on Chiliz Chain at safe.chiliz.com, deployed by Protofire, for multi-signature institutional asset management.
- [About Bridging](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging.md): Overview of bridging CHZ and other tokens between Chiliz Chain, Ethereum, Base, and Solana using Chainport, Chiliz Bridge, and LayerZero/Stargate.
- [Using Chainport](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging/using-chainport.md): Step-by-step guide to bridge ERC-20 CHZ tokens from Ethereum to wCHZ on Chiliz Chain (and back) using Dcentralab's Chainport bridge.
- [Using Chiliz Bridge](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging/using-chiliz-bridge.md): Use the Chiliz Omnichain Bridge (LayerZero) for Base and Solana transfers, or the Ethereum Bridge to move native CHZ between Ethereum Mainnet and Chiliz Chain.
- [Using Stargate](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging/using-stargate.md): Transfer tokens across 80+ chains to and from Chiliz Chain using Stargate's Simple and Advanced modes, powered by the LayerZero OFT standard.
- [Bridging stablecoins](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging/bridging-stablecoins.md): Bridge USDT (Tether) and USDC to Chiliz Chain via Chainport from Polygon or Ethereum, with contract addresses for Bridged USDT and Bridged USDC on Chiliz Chain.
- [Making your project token bridgeable](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-bridging/making-your-project-token-bridgeable.md): List your EVM project token on Chainport to make it bridgeable to Chiliz Chain, with Chainport listing requirements and liquidity pool provisioning steps.
- [About Staking](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking.md): Stake your CHZ on Chiliz Chain and earn more CHZ!
- [Stake your CHZ](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking/stake-your-chz.md): Stake your CHZ on Chiliz Chain and earn rewards!
- [Unstake your CHZ](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking/unstake-your-chz.md): Step-by-step guide to unstaking and claiming CHZ on Chiliz Mainnet and Spicy Testnet via the Chiliz Staking dApp, with epoch-based cooldown period explained.
- [Staking Rewards](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking/staking-rewards.md): How CHZ staking rewards are distributed: 65% to validators/delegators, 25% to E\&O, 10% to Community Vault, plus Snake8 probabilistic block selection based on staked CHZ.
- [Stake CHZ from your Ledger](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking/stake-chz-from-your-ledger.md): Step-by-step guide to staking CHZ on Chiliz Chain directly from a Ledger hardware wallet connected through MetaMask.
- [Chiliz Staking FAQ](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-staking/chiliz-staking-faq.md): Answers to common CHZ staking questions: epoch duration (28,800 blocks ≈ 1 day), reward compounding, 86,400-block cooldown period, Ledger support, and commission rates.
- [About Validators](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators.md): Introduction to Chiliz Chain's PoSA consensus, Main Validators, Candidate Validators, slashing mechanisms, and delegator roles in block production.
- [Defining Validators and Delegators](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/defining-validators-and-delegators.md): Definitions and roles of Chiliz Chain validators and delegators under PoSA: block production, CHZ staking, epoch elections, and reward distribution mechanics.
- [Why Become a Validator](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/why-become-a-validator.md): Benefits of becoming a Chiliz Chain validator: CHZ rewards from transaction fees and staking, governance influence, ecosystem reputation, and PoSA economics overview.
- [How to Become a Validator](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/how-to-become-a-validator.md): Requirements and registration steps to become a Chiliz Chain validator: 10M CHZ minimum stake, validator set approval, and Governance dApp registration form.
- [Running a Validator node](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/running-a-validator-node.md): Setting up a Chiliz Chain Validator node
- [How to Stop Being a Validator](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/how-to-stop-being-a-validator.md): Steps to decommission a Chiliz Chain validator node: clean shutdown, CHZ unstaking with 3-day cooldown, delegator notification, and Governance dApp deactivation.
- [About Validator slashing](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/about-validator-slashing.md): Chiliz Chain slashing penalties: Slashing Level 1 (missed blocks = lost epoch rewards) and Level 2 (extended downtime = 4-epoch jail), with unjail instructions.
- [Validator Checklist](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-validators/validator-checklist.md): Complete checklist for Chiliz Chain validator operators: stake requirements, node setup specs, registration steps, ongoing obligations, and exit procedures.
- [About Fan Tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-fan-tokens.md): Overview of Fan Tokens on Chiliz Chain: CAP-20 standard (0-decimal ERC-20), FanX/Kayen token list, 2026 decimal migration, and 2023 migration from Chiliz Legacy Chain.
- [2023 Migration of Fan Tokens to Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-fan-tokens/2023-migration-of-fan-tokens-to-chiliz-chain.md): Bridging Fan Tokens™ from Chiliz Legacy Chain to Chiliz Chain
- [2026 Migration to Decimal Fan Tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-fan-tokens/2026-migration-to-decimal-fan-tokens.md): Guide to the 2026 Fan Token upgrade to 18-decimal precision: migration portal, CEX vs. self-custody steps, and status table of all migrated Fan Token V2 contracts.
- [About Stablecoins](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-stablecoins.md): Overview of stablecoins on Chiliz Chain, including USDT and USDC bridged via Chainport, with links to supported stablecoin contracts.
- [Stablecoins on Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-stablecoins/stablecoins-on-chiliz-chain.md): Reference table of stablecoins on Chiliz Chain: AUSD0, BRZ, USDC, and USDT with contract addresses, bridge options (Chainport, Stargate), and purchase links.
- [About DAOs](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-daos.md): Guides on creating and running DAOs on Chiliz Chain using Aragon, with use-cases for Fan Token communities — fan councils, stadium experience, and treasury governance.
- [How to create your own DAO](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-daos/how-to-create-your-own-dao.md): Create a DAO on Chiliz Chain in minutes using Aragon's no-code interface — connect your wallet, select the Chiliz network, and publish your DAO.
- [How to run a DAO](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/about-daos/how-to-run-a-dao.md): Best practices for running a Chiliz Chain DAO: governance design, voting models, tokenomics, treasury management, proposal quality, and avoiding voter apathy and whale domination.
- [Glossary](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary.md): Blockchain glossary for Chiliz Chain covering CAP-20, PoSA consensus, governance, staking, validators, wallets, and wrapped CHZ (wCHZ).
- [Blockchain](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/blockchain.md): A general information about blockchain and what it is made up of
- [Consensus mechanisms](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/consensus-mechanisms.md): Glossary definitions for Proof of Stake (PoS), Proof of Staked Authority (PoSA), and Proof of Work (PoW) consensus mechanisms, with context for Chiliz Chain's Parlia engine.
- [Governance](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/governance.md): Chiliz Chain governance explained: Compound Alpha governance model, ⅔ quorum requirement, validator voting power, custom voting periods, and proposal lifecycle.
- [Validator](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/validator.md): Validator glossary entry: PoSA block producers on Chiliz Chain, selection criteria based on staked CHZ, cryptographic signing, and reward distribution.
- [Staking](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/staking.md): Staking glossary for Chiliz Chain: delegation logic, CHZ locking, validator/delegator roles, Parlia compatibility, and decentralized staking platform overview.
- [Epoch](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/epoch.md): Epoch glossary entry: Chiliz Chain's fixed time unit of 28,800 blocks (~1 day) on Mainnet, governing validator elections, reward distribution, and unstaking cooldowns.
- [Wallet](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/wallet.md): Good-to-know information about crypto wallets
- [CAP-20](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/cap-20.md): CAP-20 (Chiliz Advancement Proposal 20) explained: Chiliz Chain's ERC-20 equivalent token standard, used for Fan Tokens with 0 decimals instead of the usual 18.
- [Wrapped CHZ (wCHZ)](https://docs.chiliz.com/learn/glossary/wrapped-chz-wchz.md): Wrapped CHZ (wCHZ) explained: ERC-20/CAP-20 tokenized version of native CHZ, peg mechanics, use in DeFi and bridging, and how to wrap/unwrap on Chiliz Bridge.
- [Develop](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop.md): Developer documentation hub covering Chiliz Chain basics (RPC, deployment, verification) and advanced integrations with Biconomy, Pyth, LayerZero, and more.
- [Basics](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics.md): Core developer reference for Chiliz Chain: RPC connection, hardware wallets, smart contract deployment, verification, testnet faucets, and block explorers.
- [Connect to Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/connect-to-chiliz-chain.md): Connect to Chiliz Chain Mainnet or Spicy Testnet via public RPC endpoints (HTTP/WebSocket) or by running your own node.
- [Connect using RPC](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/connect-to-chiliz-chain/connect-using-rpc.md): Chiliz Chain Mainnet (chain ID 88888) and Spicy Testnet (chain ID 88882) RPC endpoint URLs, WebSocket connections, explorer links, and rate limit guidance.
- [Run a Chiliz Chain Node](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/connect-to-chiliz-chain/run-a-chiliz-chain-node.md): Launch, create, connect, and debug a node to sync with Chiliz Chain
- [Use a hardware wallet](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/connect-to-chiliz-chain/use-a-hardware-wallet.md): Connect a Ledger hardware wallet to Chiliz Chain via MetaMask for secure transaction signing on Mainnet and Spicy Testnet.
- [Obtain Free Testnet Tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/obtain-free-testnet-tokens.md): Get free test CHZ tokens on Spicy Testnet using the Chiliz Spicy Faucet or Tatum Faucet, with step-by-step confirmation via MetaMask and Spicy Explorer.
- [Obtain test CHZ tokens with Spicy Faucet](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/obtain-free-testnet-tokens/obtain-test-chz-tokens-with-spicy-faucet.md): Claim 20 free test CHZ tokens every 24 hours from the Chiliz Spicy Faucet by pasting your MetaMask wallet address at spicy-faucet.chiliz.com.
- [Obtain test CHZ tokens with Tatum Faucet](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/obtain-free-testnet-tokens/obtain-test-chz-tokens-with-tatum-faucet.md): Claim 10 free test CHZ tokens every 24 hours on Spicy Testnet from Tatum's faucet after registering a Tatum Dashboard account.
- [Use a Block Explorer](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/use-a-block-explorer.md): Navigate Chiliz Chain's two block explorers, Chiliscan (Routescan) and Chiliz Block Explorer (Blockscout), for transactions, NFTs, address lookup, and contract verification.
- [Write a Smart Contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/write-a-smart-contract.md): Write Chiliz Chain-compatible Solidity contracts (v0.8.24, Shanghai EVM): CAP-20 token decimals, gas mechanics, and EVM differences vs. Ethereum.
- [Deploy a Smart Contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/deploy-a-smart-contract.md): Deploy smart contracts on Chiliz Chain using Remix IDE or thirdweb, with minimum gas fee requirements (2,501 gwei) and links to verification guides.
- [Deploy with Remix](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/deploy-a-smart-contract/deploy-with-remix.md): Deploy a smart contract to Chiliz Chain using Remix IDE's web-based environment, with steps for compiling, injecting MetaMask, and confirming deployment.
- [Deploy with thirdweb](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/deploy-a-smart-contract/deploy-with-thirdweb.md): Deploy standard or custom smart contracts on Chiliz Chain Mainnet or Spicy Testnet using thirdweb's Explore library or CLI deployment tool.
- [Verify a Smart Contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract.md): Verify deployed Chiliz Chain contracts via Chiliscan (Routescan) or Chiliz Block Explorer (Blockscout), with Hardhat CLI and flattening options.
- [Verify with Chiliscan](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract/verify-with-chiliscan.md): Verify smart contracts on Chiliz Chain via Chiliscan (Routescan) using the web form, Hardhat plugin, or Routescan API.
- [Verify with Chiliz Block Explorer](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract/verify-with-chiliz-block-explorer.md): Verify smart contracts on Chiliz Chain via Chiliz Block Explorer (Blockscout) using the web form, Hardhat plugin, or Blockscout API.
- [Verify with Hardhat](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract/verify-with-hardhat.md): Verify Chiliz Chain smart contracts from the command line using the hardhat-verify plugin with Chiliscan or Chiliz Block Explorer API keys.
- [Flatten a Smart Contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract/flatten-a-smart-contract.md): Flatten a Solidity smart contract and all its dependencies into a single .sol file using Remix or Hardhat to simplify source code verification on Chiliz Chain explorers.
- [Verification Best Practices](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/verify-a-smart-contract/verification-best-practices.md): Best practices for verifying Chiliz Chain contracts: CAP-20 token specifics, Solidity 0.8.24 / Shanghai EVM requirements, and common pitfalls from Ethereum-first code.
- [Use Wrapped CHZ](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/use-wrapped-chz.md): Wrap and unwrap native CHZ to wCHZ (ERC-20/CAP-20) on Chiliz Chain Mainnet and Spicy Testnet using the Chiliz Bridge wrapper for DeFi and bridging use cases.
- [How-Tos](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/how-tos.md): Practical how-tos using Moralis, Tatum, thirdweb, and Nodit APIs on Chiliz Chain: wallet balances, transaction history, NFT metadata, and AI-assisted dApp building.
- [How to get the balance of a wallet](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/how-tos/how-to-get-the-balance-of-a-wallet.md): Retrieve CHZ and token balances for a wallet on Chiliz Chain using the Moralis Wallet API, with code samples for single and multi-asset queries.
- [How to get the history of a wallet](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/how-tos/how-to-get-the-history-of-a-wallet.md): Fetch a wallet's full transaction history on Chiliz Chain using the Moralis Wallet API, with code samples for credit/debit transaction records.
- [How to get the metadata of a specific NFT](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/how-tos/how-to-get-the-metadata-of-a-specific-nft.md): Retrieve NFT metadata (image URL, name, attributes) for a specific token on Chiliz Chain using the Moralis NFT API.
- [How to build a Chiliz dApp with AI tools](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/how-tos/how-to-build-a-chiliz-dapp-with-ai-tools.md): Use AI vibe-coding tools (Cursor, Replit, Lovable, Claude Code, Bolt, V0) to build Chiliz Chain dApps with prompts and context for EVM development.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/basics/tips-and-tricks.md): Chiliz Chain developer tips: create unlimited ERC-20 test tokens on Spicy Testnet, get current gas prices via RPC, and workaround faucet daily limits.
- [Advanced](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced.md): Advanced developer guides for Chiliz Chain: gas estimation, Fan Token tracking, account abstraction, omnichain bridging, NFT minting, and Socios.com Wallet integration.
- [Estimate gas fees](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/estimate-gas-fees.md): Estimate transaction gas fees on Chiliz Chain using cURL/RPC, Blocknative Gas Network, or ethers.js, with minimum fee guidance (2,501 gwei base, 1 gwei priority).
- [Get on-chain price feeds](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/get-asset-and-fan-token-prices.md): Read live asset and Fan Token prices directly in your smart contracts.
- [Reading prices](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/get-asset-and-fan-token-prices/reading-prices.md): Find a PriceFeed contract address, connect using the Chainlink interface, and read the current price with proper validation.
- [Best practices](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/get-asset-and-fan-token-prices/best-practices.md): Validation patterns, health status API, staleness checks, and an integration checklist for safely consuming Chiliz Chain price feeds.
- [How to get the USD price of Fan Tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/get-the-usdusd-price-of-fan-tokens.md): Get real-time USD prices for Fan Tokens on Chiliz Chain using the Pyth oracle network, with 420+ price feeds including $CHZ, $PSG, $BAR, $CITY, and other Fan Token tickers.
- [Integrate Socios.com Wallet in your dApp](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/integrate-socios.com-wallet-in-your-dapp.md): Integrate the Socios.com Wallet in your Chiliz Chain dApp's Connect Wallet flow using Reown AppKit or WalletConnect, with chain IDs 88888 (Mainnet) and 88882 (Spicy Testnet).
- [Follow transfers of a Fan Token](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/follow-transfers-of-a-fan-token.md): Track Fan Token transfer history on Chiliz Chain using subgraphs with The Graph or Goldsky — event indexing, GraphQL queries, and building a token dashboard.
- [Get Telegram notifications for Fan Token transfers](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/get-telegram-notifications-for-fan-token-transfers.md): Set up a Telegram whale-watcher bot for Fan Token transfers using Envio's indexer, capturing transfer events on Chiliz Chain and triggering alerts on threshold breaches.
- [Work with NFTs](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts.md): End-to-end NFT guide for Chiliz Chain: choosing ERC-721 or ERC-1155 contracts, IPFS hosting, minting with viem/thirdweb/Rarible, and listing on OKX.
- [Preparing the NFT files](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/preparing-the-nft-files.md): Prepare visual assets and ERC-721/ERC-1155 metadata JSON files for NFT minting on Chiliz Chain, covering image formats and metadata schema standards.
- [Choosing the right NFT contract](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/choosing-the-right-nft-contract.md): Choose between ERC-721 (unique collectibles) and ERC-1155 (multi-edition tokens) for NFT projects on Chiliz Chain, with notes on royalty and metadata update extensions.
- [Hosting your NFT on IPFS](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/hosting-your-nft-on-ipfs.md): Host NFT media files and metadata JSON on IPFS for permanent, decentralized tokenURI storage using Pinata or other IPFS providers for Chiliz Chain NFT projects.
- [Minting with viem](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/minting-with-viem.md): Mint NFTs on Chiliz Chain programmatically using TypeScript with viem or ethers.js, a deployed ERC-721 contract on Remix, and Pinata for IPFS hosting.
- [Minting with thirdweb](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/minting-with-thirdweb.md): Mint NFTs on Chiliz Chain via thirdweb's dashboard (no-code) or SDK, with built-in IPFS upload, audited contracts, and one-click collection deployment.
- [Minting with Rarible](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/minting-with-rarible.md): Mint NFTs on Chiliz Chain using the Rarible Multichain SDK with Pinata IPFS hosting and a deployed OpenZeppelin ERC-721 contract, including sell order creation.
- [Listing your NFT on OKX](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/work-with-nfts/listing-your-nft-on-okx.md): List and sell NFTs on the OKX NFT Marketplace, which has native Chiliz Chain support, requiring a verified contract and CHZ for gas fees.
- [Use Omnichain Tokens](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-omnichain-tokens.md): Complete guide to LayerZero OFT and ONFT standards on Chiliz Chain: lock-and-mint mechanics, OFT Adapter pattern, and bridging between EVM chains and Solana.
- [Bridging from Base to Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-omnichain-tokens/bridging-from-base-to-chiliz-chain.md): Deploy an OFT Adapter on Base and a Native OFT on Chiliz Chain using LayerZero v2 to bridge an existing ERC-20 token from Base to Chiliz Chain.
- [Bridging from Chiliz Chain to Base](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-omnichain-tokens/bridging-from-chiliz-chain-to-base.md): Deploy an OFT Adapter on Chiliz Chain and a Native OFT on Base using LayerZero v2 to make a Chiliz Chain token omnichain on Base.
- [Bridging from Solana to Chiliz Chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-omnichain-tokens/bridging-from-solana-to-chiliz-chain.md): Deploy an OFT Adapter on Solana and a Native OFT on Chiliz Chain using LayerZero v2 to bridge tokens from Solana to Chiliz Chain.
- [Bridging from Chiliz Chain to Solana](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-omnichain-tokens/bridging-from-chiliz-chain-to-solana.md): Deploy an OFT Adapter on Chiliz Chain and a Native OFT on Solana using LayerZero v2 to bridge tokens from Chiliz Chain to the Solana network.
- [Use Account Abstraction](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/use-account-abstraction.md): Implement account abstraction on Chiliz Chain using Biconomy's SDK: gasless transactions, batched transactions, and Smart Accounts for improved dApp UX.
- [Generate random numbers on-chain](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/advanced/generate-random-numbers-on-chain.md): Generate cryptographically secure random numbers on Chiliz Chain using Pyth Entropy — ideal for NFT mints, gaming mechanics, and prediction markets.
- [Chiliz Chain API](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/chiliz-chain-api.md): Chiliz Chain REST API reference: CHZ circulating supply by block, staking data by address, OpenAPI v3 spec, and Swagger docs at cc-api.chiliz.com.
- [Developers FAQ](https://docs.chiliz.com/develop/developers-faq.md): Developer FAQ for Chiliz Chain: Solidity 0.8.24 support, Shanghai EVM, minimum gas fees (2,501 gwei), testnet tokens, EVM compatibility, and CAP-20 details.
- [Community](https://docs.chiliz.com/community.md): Chiliz Chain community hub: ecosystem partners, developer events, Discord and Telegram channels, and the official Chiliz Chain builder logo.
- [Chiliz Chain Ecosystem](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem.md): List of wallets, tools and projects that support Chiliz Chain
- [Developer Tools](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools.md): Ecosystem directory of developer tools integrated with Chiliz Chain: RPC providers, indexing, oracles, DAOs, account abstraction, NFT SDKs, and omnichain protocols.
- [Ankr](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/ankr.md): Ankr's global RPC node network for Chiliz Chain: the infrastructure partner that helped build Chiliz Chain as a BSC fork, with dedicated Chiliz RPC endpoints.
- [Aragon](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/aragon.md): Aragon DAO creation and management platform integrated with Chiliz Chain, enabling no-code DAO deployment for Fan Token community governance.
- [Azuro](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/azuro.md): Azuro on-chain predictions and sports betting infrastructure layer on Chiliz Chain, with thousands of sports markets and permissionless liquidity access.
- [Biconomy](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/biconomy.md): Biconomy SDK for Chiliz Chain: account abstraction toolkit enabling gasless and batched transactions, Smart Accounts, and one-click user onboarding for dApps.
- [Blocknative](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/blocknative.md): Blocknative mempool monitoring and gas estimation tools for Chiliz Chain, delivering 600+ gas price estimates per second via the Gas Network.
- [Goldsky](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/goldsky.md): Goldsky real-time blockchain indexing for Chiliz Chain: hosted subgraphs compatible with The Graph, instant GraphQL APIs, and data streaming pipelines.
- [Hyperlane](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/hyperlane.md): Hyperlane open interoperability framework for Chiliz Chain: cross-chain message passing, ERC-20 and NFT bridging, and interchain application development.
- [LayerZero](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/layerzero.md): LayerZero omnichain messaging protocol on Chiliz Chain: OFT/ONFT standards for native cross-chain token transfers without wrapping, connecting 170+ blockchains.
- [Lumx](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/lumx.md): Lumx APIs and SDKs for Chiliz Chain: full-stack blockchain toolkit for companies building end-to-end Web3 applications on Chiliz.
- [Moralis](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/moralis.md): Moralis Web3 data APIs for Chiliz Chain: wallet balances, transaction history, NFT metadata, and token data via EVM-compatible endpoints.
- [Pyth](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/pyth.md): Pyth oracle network on Chiliz Chain: 420+ real-time price feeds including Fan Token tickers ($CHZ, $ACM, $BAR, $CITY, $PSG) for DeFi smart contracts.
- [Reown](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/reown.md): Reown (formerly WalletConnect) AppKit and WalletKit toolkits for Chiliz Chain dApps, enabling multi-wallet Connect Wallet modals including the Socios.com Wallet.
- [Rarible](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/rarible.md): Rarible multichain NFT protocol integrated with Chiliz Chain: SDK for minting, sell orders, royalty enforcement, and real-time NFT data for SportFi dApps.
- [Tatum](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/tatum.md): Tatum unified Web3 SDK for Chiliz Chain: RPC access, token and NFT APIs, and testnet faucet supporting 90+ blockchain protocols.
- [The Graph](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/the-graph.md): The Graph decentralized indexing protocol for Chiliz Chain: deploy subgraphs to query Fan Token transfers, governance votes, and on-chain events via GraphQL.
- [Thirdweb](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/thirdweb.md): Thirdweb full-stack Web3 platform supporting Chiliz Chain Mainnet (chain ID 88888) and Spicy Testnet: smart contract deployment, wallets, payments, and SDKs.
- [Web3Auth](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/developer-tools/web3auth.md): Web3Auth pluggable wallet infrastructure for Chiliz Chain dApps: OAuth social logins, embedded wallets, and seamless Web3 user onboarding without seed phrases.
- [Custody solutions](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/custody-solutions.md): Institutional custody solutions for Chiliz Chain assets, including Cobo and Fireblocks MPC and multi-signature wallet services.
- [Cobo](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/custody-solutions/cobo.md): Cobo custody solutions for Chiliz Chain: institutional MPC wallets, multi-signature vaults, staking, and Wallet-as-a-Service for CHZ and Fan Token management.
- [Fireblocks](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/custody-solutions/fireblocks.md): Fireblocks institutional custody platform for Chiliz Chain: secure digital asset transfer, settlement, and Wallet-as-a-Service (WaaS) for exchanges and financial institutions.
- [Wallets](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/wallets.md): Wallet-as-a-service and embedded wallet providers integrated with Chiliz Chain, including Magic and Privy for seamless user onboarding.
- [Magic](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/wallets/magic.md): Magic.link wallet-as-a-service for Chiliz Chain: passwordless authentication, non-custodial wallet management, NFT capabilities, and MetaMask/Coinbase Wallet integration.
- [Privy](https://docs.chiliz.com/community/chiliz-chain-ecosystem/wallets/privy.md): Privy privacy-first wallet platform for Chiliz Chain dApps: encrypted key management, GDPR/CCPA compliance, granular access control, and user-controlled wallet options.

- [Chiliz Chain Changelog](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog.md): Changelog hub for Chiliz Chain: governance proposals and decisions, blockchain code upgrades (hard forks), and outage reports with transparency links.
- [Governance Proposals & Decisions](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions.md): Full index of Chiliz Chain governance proposals from validators, from the Dragon8 tokenomics upgrade through Snake8, Pepper8, and the 2026 contract cleanup.
- [February 2026: Contract Removal and Clean-Up Proposal](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/february-2026-contract-removal-and-clean-up-proposal.md): CIP-050 proposal to add a removeContract function to the Chiliz Chain Contract Registry and remove orphaned LayerZero contracts as a prerequisite for Omnichain integration.
- [October 2025: Snake8 Hard Fork](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/october-2025-snake8-hard-fork.md): Snake8 hard fork (October 2025): randomized block producer selection weighted by staked CHZ, replacing equal block distribution to incentivize validator ecosystem contributions.
- [August 2025: Pepper8 Proposal](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/august-2025-pepper8-proposal.md): Pepper8 governance proposal (applied August 27, 2025): integration of Paribu Net into Chiliz Chain, deprecation of $PRB, and migration of user balances to $CHZ.
- [February 2025: New Validator Proposals](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/february-2025-new-validator-proposals.md): February 2025 governance proposals to decentralize Chiliz Chain further by expanding block-producing validators and onboarding CoinTelegraph as a new validator.
- [December 2024: Governance Update Proposals](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/december-2024-governance-update-proposals.md): December 2024 governance update: expanded active validator set, new validator addition, and changes to jailing and unstaking period lengths.
- [May 2024: Dragon8 (Tokenomics 2.0) Proposal](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/may-2024-dragon8-tokenomics-2.0-proposal.md): Dragon8 governance proposal for CHZ Tokenomics 2.0: dynamic inflation model, EIP-1559 fee burn, 65/25/10 reward allocation split, and long-term ecosystem funding.
- [2024 Dragon8 hard fork announcement](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/governance-proposals-and-decisions/2024-dragon8-hard-fork-announcement.md): Announcement of the Dragon8 hard fork in May 2024: introduction of Tokenomics 2.0 with inflation/burn model, EIP-1559, and new developer tools on Chiliz Chain.
- [Blockchain code changes](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/blockchain-code-changes.md): Chronological log of all Chiliz Chain code merges from Ethereum and BSC, including the Snake8, Pepper8, and Dragon8 hard fork changes.
- [Outage reports](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/outage-reports.md): Historical record of major Chiliz Chain outages, scheduled maintenance events, and links to the Chiliz status page.
- [Details on the May 21st outage](https://docs.chiliz.com/chiliz-chain-changelog/outage-reports/details-on-the-may-21st-outage.md): Post-mortem of the May 21st 2024 Dragon8 hard fork failure on Chiliz Chain Mainnet: root cause, rollback, block recovery, and revised hard fork ETA of June 17th 2024.
- [Doc Updates](https://docs.chiliz.com/doc-updates.md): The changelog for this documentation site.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://docs.chiliz.com/readme.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
